are_you_ok.title: Sunday was Denver's hottest day in more than 8 years
are_you_ok.summary: A record-breaking heat wave defined the week: health specialists warned of extreme risk for people and pets mid-week (Jul 25), and Sunday (Jul 27) became Denver's hottest day in more than 8 years. A wide-reaching check-in for anyone vulnerable to the heat.
are_you_ok.description: Denver experiences record-breaking heat as temperatures reach 103 degrees, the highest in over eight years.
